Title: Now Available: Resource-centric log queries in the Azure Monitor Query libraries

Body.Content: The Azure Monitor Query client libraries have supported log queries via Log Analytics workspace ID since their inception. Earlier this month, we added support for another log query type—log queries via Azure resource ID. Learn why this feature is useful at Resource-centric log queries with the Azure Monitor Query libraries. Try it today in your .NET, Go, Java, JavaScript, or Python applications.
